PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for wastebin. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Require owner authentication for every application route.

TMPDIR.description: Tmpdir for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: Run as root so the scratch image can write the Railway volume; no shell is available in this image.

WASTEBIN_BASE_URL.description: Wastebin base url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

WASTEBIN_SIGNING_KEY.description: Generated wastebin signing key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

WASTEBIN_ADDRESS_PORT.description: Wastebin address port for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

WASTEBIN_DATABASE_PATH.description: Wastebin database path for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

WASTEBIN_MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: Wastebin max body size for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

WASTEBIN_PASSWORD_SALT.description: Generated wastebin password salt. Keep private and preserve with backups.
